reason: The cited evidence (E1) only shows that a WTaTiVZr HEA film retains strength and ductility after annealing better than pure W, attributing this to resistance to grain growth and pore formation, not to SRO clusters. It provides no support for the key premises about SRO formation, dislocation pinning, or the specific deformation mechanisms proposed.
premises: Annealing induces atomic-scale SRO clusters in WTaTiVZr HEA
SRO clusters act as dislocation pinning centers
SRO clusters promote uniform plastic deformation and increase work-hardening
SRO clusters delay crack initiation and enhance toughness
